info.title: MindSync API
info.description: Study task management API: a local heuristic plus locally trained models (task fit, wellbeing / stress risk). No external AI service is used. See the project report for the full system design.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.default: This estimate applies the scoring rule of a public student-survey dataset to your answers. It is not a medical or psychological diagnosis and it does not predict burnout. If you feel unwell or overwhelmed, please talk to someone you trust, your university's student support or your doctor.

DeleteAccount.title: DeleteAccount
DeleteAccount.description: Deleting an account needs the password again, so a stolen token cannot erase everything.

FeedbackCreate.title: FeedbackCreate
FeedbackCreate.description: Situation numbers only (no task text) plus the student's yes/no answer.

RecommendationOut.title: RecommendationOut
RecommendationOut.description:
The response returned by GET /recommend.

Everything here is produced by LOCAL code: the heuristic ranks the tasks
(app/heuristic.py), the trained task-fit model adds a probability
(app/ml), and app/explain.py turns the numbers into a sentence. No
external AI service is involved.

TopicDetails.title: TopicDetails
TopicDetails.description: Optional follow-up answers. Only the ones that belong to the chosen task type are ever shown.
